text:
marta: Quick kickoff  We have the "Optimizer" webinar on May 13. Need a compact social plan for X + LinkedIn to drive signups and seed a cost/latency benchmark story. Focus: product teams and platform leads.
rachel: Proposed channel split: X = 3 short threads (tease, live reminder, highlight), LinkedIn = 2 longform posts (announcement + recap). Also a short CEO quote for LinkedIn card.
sam: I can prep creative: hero banner, 20-30s demo clip optimized for autoplay, 2 quote cards, benchmark embed chart. Need final copy and UTMs by Thu EOD.
marta: Asset list (final): hero.jpg (16:9), clip30.mp4, quote_ceo.png, quote_engineering.png, bench_viz.png, reg_link + UTM string. Legal must sign off on bench language before publish.
kevin: Seedlist plan: split into Tier A (enterprise) and Tier B (growth). Tier A gets personalized DM follow-up from SDRs within 24h. Tier B gets automated nurture sequence. I'll produce the CSV.
arya: Routing rules: tag = webinar_may2026. CSV headers I'll need: `email,name,company,title,score,tag,sdr_queue,priority,followup_by`. Paste sample CSV in #operations when ready.
sam: Draft captions below. X teaser (short): "Join our webinar: reduce inference cost + latency. Live May 13. Register -> <link>". LinkedIn announcement (long): "How product teams can ship LLM features faster by optimizing inference. Join our live demo + benchmark".
marta: Two caption variants for LinkedIn please for A/B: Variant 1 (concise, product): "Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference economics. Webinar May 13." Variant 2 (story): "We measured 2.5x latency improvement and 40% cost reduction in real workloads  webinar shows how." (legal pending).
kevin: Scheduling ask: can we do an early-bird X thread Mon May 12 08:00 PT to catch APAC? Also boost high-converting posts for 48h post-webinar.
arya: For no-shows: automated nurture at 24h and 7 days with on-demand recording. Also mark no-shows in CRM with `no_show_may13`.
ops-bot: Scheduled: X teaser -> 2026-05-12T15:00:00Z (owner: kevin). LinkedIn announce -> 2026-05-12T19:00:00Z (owner: sam). X reminder -> 2026-05-13T16:45:00Z (owner: sam).
sam: Upload link: https://drive.google.com/optimizer-webinar-assets (contains hero.jpg, clip30.mp4, bench_viz.png). Filenames must match exactly.
marta: Quick copy guidance: keep tone direct, emphasize measurables, avoid superlatives. Benchmark tagline: "Real workloads: 2-3x latency improvement, ~40% lower token cost for 1k-token prompts." Legal will confirm exact phrasing.
kevin: I'll prepare seed CSV and send to rachel+arya for routing verification by Fri 11am PT. Can we include company vertical column? helps SDR routing.
arya: Yes add `vertical` column. Also adding `utm_source=webinar_may2026&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=optimizer_launch` as the canonical UTM to use.
sam: For LinkedIn A/B, Variant A (short): "Predictable inference economics for teams." Variant B (long): "See the benchmark and demo: how we reduced latency and cost without sacrificing quality."
marta: Post-launch ops: monitor social sentiment and CTRs for first 24h. If bench claims get pushback, legal + comms will draft a response. Who owns first 12h monitoring?
kevin: I'll take the first 8h; rachel can cover next 8h.
rachel: Happy to. I'll post quick status in #marketing every 2h during monitoring window.
arya: Once I get CSV, I'll wire the routing rules and create SDR followup templates. Template snippet for 24h follow-up: "Thanks for registering for the webinar. Quick question: are you evaluating LLM serving for product features?"
marta: Solid. Next check-in Thu 10am PT to confirm assets and legal copy. Thanks team :raised_hands:
kevin: +1
sam: +1
